delta_evidence.summary: Server-generated Git snapshot delta changes 5 path(s).

assignment_id.description: Exact assignment_id supplied by this risk-scout assignment.

affected.description: True only when the replacement diff changes the failure path, uncertainty or required confirmation, newly selects this dimension, or introduces a finding in it.

evidence.description: Concrete diff, deployment, trust-boundary, data, reversibility, or operational evidence supporting this rating.

lens.description: Exact review-dimension identifier supplied by the assignment.

material_impact.description: Concrete consequence if the plausible failure occurs. Use none only when risk is none and uncertainty is false.

plausible_failure.description: Concrete trigger-to-failure path. Use none only when risk is none and uncertainty is false.

risk.description: none means no concrete plausible failure path; low is bounded and readily recoverable; medium has material but contained impact; high can seriously compromise required behavior or protection; exceptional matches a supported exceptional trigger and requires a second independent pass.

uncertain.description: True when available evidence cannot rule the failure path in or out; uncertainty selects review coverage.

exceptional_triggers.description: Supported exceptional-risk boundaries evidenced by this change; required when overall_risk is exceptional.

causality.description: Relationship to the reviewed diff: caused introduces the failure path; worsened materially increases a pre-existing path's likelihood or impact; pre-existing is unchanged by the diff; incidental is real but unrelated to the diff and supplied scope; uncertain means evidence cannot resolve the relationship.

evidence.description: Direct code, diff, test, or deployment evidence supporting the finding.

finding_id.description: Stable identifier for one semantic failure path. Reuse it across scout, lens, delta, and verifier phases even when the path or line changes.

lens.description: Exact review dimension that discovered this failure path.

likelihood.description: Probability on the reviewed deployment path: rare requires exceptional conditions; unlikely is credible but atypical; possible has a realistic trigger; likely is expected in normal use; observed is reproduced or directly evidenced.

line.description: One-based line number when a single changed line anchors the failure path.

material_impact.description: Concrete consequence if this finding's failure path occurs.

message.description: Concise statement of the defect and its consequence.

path.description: For a blocking caused/worsened security or human-safety finding, the in-scope changed path that would be remediated.

safety_impact.description: Domain-specific consequence: none has no impact; minor is bounded and readily recoverable; moderate is meaningful but contained; major seriously compromises people, confidentiality, integrity, or availability; critical is catastrophic, systemic, or irreversible.

scenario.description: Concrete trigger and execution path that exposes the defect.

security_impact.description: Domain-specific consequence: none has no impact; minor is bounded and readily recoverable; moderate is meaningful but contained; major seriously compromises people, confidentiality, integrity, or availability; critical is catastrophic, systemic, or irreversible.

severity.description: Consequence if the failure occurs, independent of likelihood: CRITICAL is catastrophic, systemic, or irreversible; MAJOR materially breaks required behavior or protection; MINOR is bounded and recoverable; TRIVIAL has negligible behavioral impact.

overall_risk.description: Must equal or exceed the highest dimension risk. Exceptional also requires a supported exceptional trigger and at least one exceptional dimension.

shared_test_evidence_id.description: Exact id of the shared test evidence supplied by this assignment.

split_rationale.description: Concrete evidence for the selected scope-growth trigger.

split_required.description: True only for a new independently ownable subsystem or a diff that cannot be verified and shipped as one coherent change.

subagent_key.description: Exact subagent_key supplied by this risk-scout assignment.
